answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 28250 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Sometimes people ask me whether am i wahabi or sunni? What to answer them? Question: Sometimes people ask me whether am i wahabi or sunni? What to answer them? Answer ID: 28250 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 59/49/H=1432) You should answer, "I am Ahl al-Sunnat wal-Jama'at Hanafi Muslim. I am true devotee of elderly saints; I hate Ahl al Bid'ah. I have no Islamic relation with those who practice bid’at and carry out such practices that are against Sunnah, and so on. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
